verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents cap table management that updates automatically and links to the documents in its data room. Award agreements are tied to board consents, exercises and stock certificates, and option grants with vesting schedules are covered, with ASC 718 reports giving auditors an output. However, share classes and SAFEs are never named (only convertible notes are), and investors relying on the cap table as a shared source is not documented. Missing for 10: share class management, SAFE support, investor-facing cap table access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on
